article.title: Very good sentences thwarted markets in everything
article.excerpt: “Such exorbitant commercialism must stop,” said Jan Tönjes, chief editor of Germany’s St. Georg magazine. At a recent show in Wiesbaden, he said, a woman tried to buy a rubber glove that the horse had spat on as a souvenir. The article is here (interesting throughout) and for a related pointer (not to this passage) I thank Michelle Dawson .
